purpose: Known-broken fixture: a full-rewrite pair that lexical Jaccard must miss (0.05-0.24 genuinely-distinct band) and concept-axis cosine must fire on. Re-running this control is the reviewer job. Blind adjudication never receives the scores.

a.text: checkpoint-resume-workflow Kill a workflow mid-run at a stage boundary. Persist a checkpoint of completed stages. Resume the same inputs from that checkpoint without replaying prior side effects. Refuse a corrupted checkpoint rather than a partial run. kill-mid-run persist-checkpoint resume-same-inputs skip-replay reject-corrupt

b.text: abort-snapshot-continue Abort the job halfway through a step edge. Snapshot done stages into durable store. Continue the identical inputs off stored progress and skip already-applied mutations. Reject a damaged savepoint instead of emitting a half result. abort-halfway durable-snapshot continue-identical-payload skip-applied-mutations reject-damaged-savepoint
